coverage_policy.rationale: The current visible inventory requires five full-frame journey environments, six actor/threat silhouettes, three combat pickup/projectile/impact families, fifteen active authored UI material/folio/icon/portrait families including UIKIT-007/008, PORTRAIT-001/002 and ACHIEVEICON-001, three cultivation sigils, and two bundled typography families. Superseded UIKIT-002 lacquer/compact/icon files and UIKIT-003 commands are not inflated into the floor; native compact controls and byte-identical combat derivatives are usages rather than false distinct assets.

groups.coverage_basis: Title, hub/meta navigation, three selectable stage identities and combat backgrounds declared by the state/UI inventory need distinct authored full-frame art.

usages.rationale: The 16:9 title art fills the centered reference canvas without non-uniform scaling; runtime text remains separate.
One authored sect location anchors the connected meta loop while foreground ritual objects distinguish each surface.
The arena plate remains aspect-preserved behind gameplay and modal overlays, with the center kept readable for actors.
A separate cinnabar-threat environment makes the second stage visibly distinct in selection and runtime presentation.
A separate ruined-heaven-gate plate supplies the final stage identity and maintains the same safe center composition.

groups.coverage_basis: The art bible and enemy director require a readable player idle/move pair, three ordinary threat silhouettes, an elite use and one unmistakable boss at runtime scale.

usages.rationale: Bottom-anchored uniform scaling preserves the accepted silhouette and 76 px body-height contract.
The movement family swaps at the same bottom pivot and target height as idle, avoiding scale or foot drift.
The compact floating silhouette remains visibly smaller than player and beast roles.
The broad quadruped mass is uniformly scaled and remains distinct from upright enemies.
The upright corrupted cultivator uses the standard late-run target height.
The elite reuses the accepted identity at a larger uniform scale with separate runtime tint and health presentation, so it is not counted as a false distinct source asset.
The broad horned boss preserves its near-square silhouette at 150 px while telegraph geometry remains a separate layer.

groups.coverage_basis: The combat/progression loop needs a reward pickup, a readable flying-sword family and an authored hit/burst family; byte-identical empowered derivatives are usages, not extra distinct assets.

usages.rationale: The compact seed/pearl remains aspect-preserved and is reinforced by halo, bob and magnet motion.
Runtime uniform scaling and parent rotation preserve the thin flying-sword silhouette.
The byte-identical derivative uses a larger target height plus rank-aware tint/trail, so it remains one source family.
Small impacts preserve the accepted broken-seal aspect while fading and scaling through the effect lifetime.
The byte-identical burst derivative scales uniformly and combines with procedural radial geometry rather than counting as a second source asset.

groups.coverage_basis: V3 runtime convergence now has a clean Godot 4.6.2 parse, current desktop/844x390 captures and a fresh served Chromium export. UIKIT-007 owns the title/header/modal/result/skill/touch family and the live boss bar; UIKIT-008 owns distinct controls; PORTRAIT-001/002 and ACHIEVEICON-001 provide dossier, HUD and achievement identities. status_plaque remains the only deliberately unbound UIKIT-007 region. Independent visual review and device/cross-browser gates remain open.

usages.rationale: The broad blue-black center stretches while the clipped rim and jade corner remain protected on the largest narrative shells.
A restrained middle margin protects the thin frame across tall rails, index panels, records and the wide expedition slab.
Modal and portrait-guard layouts retain the same matte material while runtime text, sigil and destructive wording stay separate.

One matte blue-black plaque supplies material continuity; gold/jade/cinnabar variants are encoded by restrained runtime tint, edge and wording rather than separate glossy assets. Compact controls intentionally skip this texture.
Scroll rollers and flourishes remain protected around variable paper fields and modal text.
Seal notches and paper edges stay intact around stage/loadout/dossier content.
The complete irregular folio is aspect-fitted inside its 330×450 control bounds; text is constrained to the detected inner silhouette.
The narrow jade folio preserves its own silhouette instead of being stretched to match the sword folio.
Accepted v2 runtime art is uniformly fitted; the superseded v1 source is excluded from runtime coverage.
Rarity frames and compare tooltip are cropped from dedicated atlas regions with runtime text above them.
Command plaque and medallion/lock regions establish the five-slot combat rail.
The 380x684 source region is aspect-preserved inside a 720x820 desktop title control while all title copy remains live.
The dedicated quiet-center header region protects bronze ends while headings and currency stay separate runtime nodes.
The dedicated quiet-center guard preserves its bronze clamps while live warning, title and action nodes remain separate.
The result plate protects its outer seal hardware around three live stat columns.
The complete rail silhouette is fitted as one authored chrome layer beneath live icons, bindings, locks and cooldowns.
The authored atlas bar and dedicated boss portrait carry live name and health nodes above the encounter without covering the boss body.
Attack and joystick regions are drawn into independently computed square safe-area targets; the current 844x390 native and Web captures show no blocking distortion or overlap.
Primary, secondary, back, destructive, stepper and confirm roles use separate silhouettes while captions and state remain live.
Six dossier portraits give each threat and the Thanh Vân Hồ companion a dedicated authored identity without replacing combat animation.
The player HUD and boss bar use dedicated portraits while animated actors retain separate sprite sheets.
Each milestone receives a distinct engraved seal; progress, title and state remain runtime text.
Each item receives a dedicated material silhouette inside a protected transparent cell; rarity/title remain dynamic nodes.
Bold skill silhouettes stay separate from medallion/lock/cooldown chrome and remain readable at phone scale; the companion assist uses the same authored family.

groups.coverage_basis: Every Vietnamese UI surface points at bundled local font files: Be Vietnam Pro Regular owns body/HUD text, Be Vietnam Pro SemiBold owns actions and compact emphasis, and Literata owns large ritual titles. Official-source hashes, OFL files and FontFile imports are recorded; the clean project parse plus current 1600x900/844x390 native and served Chromium captures show live Vietnamese glyphs. Cross-browser and physical low-DPI review remain open.

usages.rationale: Regular carries Vietnamese body/HUD text and SemiBold carries buttons, tabs and eyebrows without baking copy into raster assets.
The variable roman face is reserved for large ritual headings; Vietnamese copy remains a live node and falls back to the body family by role if needed.

groups.coverage_basis: The three doctrine/permanent-technique paths require independent sword, jade-body and spirit-well silhouettes across loadout, technique previews, combat HUD/VFX, touch controls and portrait guard.

usages.rationale: The transparent square sigil is uniformly scaled across doctrine and rank-evolution previews.
The jade-shell silhouette remains square and readable without number-only upgrade communication.
The spirit-vortex silhouette is reused coherently across doctrine, VFX and HUD contexts.
The same authored qi-vortex language supports the touch skill and rotation plaque while input behavior remains separately encoded.
